title: Codex worker delegations that end their turn normally are reported with status "failed" (fan-in wait reports failed too)
outcome: A worker delegation whose child ends its turn normally, with a result or with a question for its parent, is reported as completed (or as waiting for its parent), not failed. A refused child tool call, such as a child trying to mail its parent, does not by itself turn a normally ended turn into "failed". Fan-in waits report the same status.
acceptance: Root cause identified with file:line for how a normally ended Codex worker turn becomes DelegationStatus::Failed (for example a refused tool call during the turn, or the child session's terminal status mapping).

Behavioural tests: a worker turn that ends normally with a result is reported completed; a worker turn that ends normally asking its parent a question is reported in a non-failed state that a follow-up can continue; a genuinely failed turn (runtime error, crash) is still reported failed; termal_resume_after_delegations / wait results agree with the delegation status.
Review pair clean and full gate green on the landing input.
